contexts.text: These colours are... from the variegation of spiritual light.
The two origins of all the variegations of light and shade there. Explained.
Their speech... consists of variegations, that is, modifications, of heavenly light, in which is heavenly heat.
The derivative variegations are what are called colours.
Thus (evils and falsities) are variegated (by goods and truths)...
Ring-straked () = truths which are strewed and mixed with evils. AC 4005:2, Explained. AC 4020. AC 4022. AC 4080.

Around the column was a lucidity which was variegated by something shining white, presenting colours, by which was signified the state of the Spiritual Church... (It) = the Intellectual in which there is a new Voluntary from the Lord.
All the thought of the Angels is effected through the variegation of that light, as is also the thought of man...

The variegations or modifications of the light of Heaven are thus the variegations, and, so to speak, the modifications, of wisdom and intelligence, and consequently of good and truth... That colours... are variegations and modifications of that light, and consequently of intelligence and wisdom. References. AC 9833:2. AC 9868:2.
Hence the cloud variegated by the fire yields wonderful aspects. Explained.
Therefore the modifications of that light and flame are variegations of truth and good, thus of intelligence and wisdom.
From the tone, variegated by the ideas in the words, the interior Angels perceive the ruling love.

The planes of this light, in which come forth the variegations as of colours, are the interiors of the mind; and the confirmations of Divine Truths by such things as are in nature... produce these variegations.
As (Spirits) have light, they have also the variegation of light, which presents colours. Light without variegation is not possible, for it is to them shade: hence they have colours...
Ideas are formed (there) by means of ineffable varieties... by shade and lights, by their determinations, and by other variegations.
Thou didst make to thee high places adorned with divers colours () = truths falsified.
King's daughters arrayed in cloaks of various colours(). AE 863:15.
The colours (there) are variegated more than (here); and there are variegations of their light which correspond to their love or good, and to their wisdom or truth.
They showed that the colours are nothing else than variegations of the flaming light and the shining white light, in objects, in accordance with the forms of these.
